_about: Sea step 9 dungeons (core/sea/dungeon_rules.gd, game/sea_dungeon.gd, game/sea_dungeons.gd; LOCKED: hand-made from a room kit, own space behind the door). Each dungeon is drawn from `map` (rows of cells `tile` m: '#' wall, ' ' nothing, any other letter = floor; letters in `legend` are things standing there). Kinds: arrive (where you come in), exit (the gate back out), door (open: 'key' = a key unlocks it for good, 'plates' = while every plate in `plates` is pressed by a player or a block; latch true = stays open once opened, 'lever' = while `lever` is pulled), plate, lever, block (pushed one cell away from you with interact), key (a small key for this dungeon), chest (loot table of data/sea/encounters.json). The space lies at sea coordinates space.first_x + slot x space.step_x, space.y, space.z (far off the map, above the water); a player whose sea y is over indoor_y is inside one. entrance = the gate on the island (sea x, z; yaw degrees; it finds the ground below itself). torch_every: a torch on every n-th wall cell beside a floor. env: the light inside. ALL NAMES / NUMBERS MINE.
